svg.title: Deep learning landscape overview
svg.desc: A structural diagram showing the major areas of deep learning knowledge for AI engineers, organized from foundations through architectures to training and deployment.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the mathematical foundations of deep learning in detail')
sendPrompt('How does backpropagation work in neural networks?')
sendPrompt('Explain activation functions in deep learning')
sendPrompt('Explain CNNs and how they work for computer vision')
sendPrompt('How do RNNs and LSTMs work?')
sendPrompt('Explain optimization algorithms like Adam and SGD for training neural networks')
sendPrompt('How do you prevent overfitting in deep learning?')
sendPrompt('Explain loss functions used in deep learning')
sendPrompt('Explain NLP and large language models')
sendPrompt('Explain deep learning for computer vision tasks')
sendPrompt('What is reinforcement learning and how does deep RL work?')
sendPrompt('How do you deploy and serve deep learning models in production?')
sendPrompt('Explain fine-tuning and transfer learning techniques')
sendPrompt('Explain model compression and quantization techniques')

svg.text: Click any node to explore that topic in depth
